description: Identify which room block the CI menu black table lives in: --debug-hide-menu + --debug-hide-bg-xlu skips ONLY the room XLU geometry. If the black table disappears, it's an XLU block (translucent-classed but rendering black -> fast3d blend/colour issue). If it remains, it's an OPA block (misfiled / opaque). Swap to --debug-hide-bg-opa to confirm the complement.
